source.staging: Clean source archive in this workspace; never COPY D:/AI or model folders

buildCandidates.network: Build dependencies only; separate from runtime network policy
buildCandidates.resourceEnforcement: Require a separately inspected capped builder cgroup and a harmless quota test before compilation; ordinary Docker build flags are not assumed to enforce these caps

runtimeCandidates.configuration: Separate Linux config under a disposable session; original Windows config stays read-only

requiredBeforeBuild: Owner approval of the CPU compilation workload and exact capped-builder manifest
Validated CPU temperature provider with freshness checks; apply the approved CPU-only unknown-throttle exception and 92 C start / 97 C stop controls
Independent watchdog adapted to the exact builder identity and tested before compiler admission
Disk reserve and dependency download budget measured and approved
Source/archive verification and full dependency hashes or explicit reproducibility limitations
requiredBeforeModelLaunch: Explicit owner approval bound to the immutable full live policy and launch manifest
Known built image digest and CPU/driver compatibility checks
All required live telemetry channels and fail-closed sample freshness checks
Independent watchdog guarding the exact live session; daemon/host/suspend failure gaps resolved
Approved normal and emergency stop deadlines; two-container shutdown-order tests
Authenticated request/token/file gate and restricted OpenCode workspace
Validation of mmap data compatibility and memory/VRAM budgets without automatic configuration upgrades
